# **II. Software Requirement Specification**

## **1\. Product Overview** {#1.-product-overview}

Automated ice cream Brewing System is a modern software platform designed to centrally manage a network of automated ice cream vending machines (kiosks) from participating organizations, including the kiosk‘s system, which connects and communicates with its devices to process orders. The system aims to automate the ice cream sales process, minimize human intervention, enhance customer experience, and enable remote supervision across multiple locations.

The system interfaces with end-customers (ice cream buyers), payment gateways, inventory management systems, technical support teams, administrators, and external suppliers. Key features include menu and price management, real-time device monitoring, automated promotions, payment integration, inventory tracking, and maintenance alerts.

The context diagram below illustrates the system boundary and all external entities that interact with the Automated Brewing ice cream System. It performs the flow of data and control signals between the system and other parties, ensuring clear separation between the internal processes and the outside world.

## **2\. User Requirements** {#2.-user-requirements}

### **2.1 Actors** {#2.1-actors}

| \# | Actor | Description |
| ----- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | System Administrator | Responsible for managing the entire system, including all kiosks and device settings. Monitors device statuses, handles system-wide configurations, and oversees performance across organizations. Can receive alerts (e.g., machine errors, low supplies) and forward them to Organization Administrators. |
| 2 | Organization Administrator | Manages kiosks and devices owned by their organization. Monitors kiosk activity, views operational status, and reviews sales reports. Handles basic configurations such as menu updates or kiosk availability. |
| 3 | Customer | Individuals who place ice cream orders and interact directly with the kiosk or the mobile app. |
| 4 | Kiosk System | The system interacts to make ice creams. |

#### ***3.1.4 Non-Screen Functions***

| \# | Feature | System Function | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | Payment Management | Auto Expired Payment | Automatically checks all payments and marks them as Expired if the payment time has exceeded the allowed limit. |
| 2 | Order Management | Auto Cancel Order | Automatically cancels associated orders if the corresponding payment is expired, without requiring user interaction. |
| 3 | Kiosk Data Synchronize | Tracking Audit Entities | Automatically triggers an audit tracking when changes occur in the database. |
| 4 | Kiosk Management | Auto Generate Webhook | Automatically triggers to create all webhooks when  a kiosk is created. |
| 5 | Kiosk Management | Auto Register Cloudflare Tunnel | Automatically registers and establishes a Cloudflare Tunnel for each kiosk during initialization, allowing secure remote access to kiosk services without exposing the local network. |
| 6 | Kiosk Management | Auto Register Device to Azure IoT Hub | Automatically registers a kiosk device with Azure IoT Hub upon first setup or activation, enabling secure cloud-to-device communication and remote device management. |
| 7 | Organization Management | Auto Create Admin Account on Organization Creation | When a new organization is created, the system automatically generates a default admin account for that organization to enable initial access and management without manual user registration. |
| 8 | Notification | Send Account Credentials via Email | After the admin account is created, the system sends an email containing login credentials (username and password) to the provided organization contact email. |
| 9 | Order Management | Handle Payment Callback from Third-Party | The system receives and validates payment callback data (e.g., from VNPay or MPOS) to confirm transaction status after a user completes payment. |
| 10 | Order Management | Notify Device and Trigger ice cream Process | After successful payment validation, the system sends a command to the kiosk/tablet device to display order status and activates the ice cream cup-making workflow (e.g., robot, ice, ice cream machine). |
| 11 | Kiosk Data Synchronize | Push Sync Data to Kiosk Device | The system automatically sends pending task data (e.g., product recipes, workflow steps, configurations) from the cloud or central server to the target kiosk device to ensure it is up to date. |
| 12 | Kiosk Data Synchronize | Receive and Process Sync Data on Kiosk | The kiosk device automatically receives synchronization data (e.g., product info, workflows, steps) from the server, parses the payload, and updates its local storage or runtime configuration accordingly. |
| 13 | Kiosk Management | Export Kiosk Configuration File | Upon kiosk creation or during installation, the system automatically generates a configuration file (e.g., JSON, YAML) containing all necessary information such as device IDs, network settings, tunnel credentials, Azure IoT keys, and assigned workflows. |
| 14 | Notification | Send Ban Notification to Affected Users | The system sends real-time or email notifications to all users in the banned organization to inform them about the ban and reason (if applicable). |
| 15 | Kiosk Data Synchronize | Auto Delete Synced Data | After synchronization is completed and confirmed, the system automatically deletes or archives corresponding SyncTask and SyncEvent records to free up storage and keep the database clean. |
| 16 | System Monitoring | Auto Logging and Tracing | The system automatically captures logs, traces, and exception data across services, enabling centralized monitoring and diagnostics. |
| 17 | System Database Management | Auto Apply Database Migrations | On application startup or deployment, the system automatically applies pending database migrations to ensure the database schema is up-to-date with the current application version. |
| 18 | System Performance Optimization | Auto Cache with Change Tracking | The system automatically caches frequently accessed data in memory (e.g., product lists, workflows). It detects changes in the database and refreshes the cache when data is updated. Similar queries are served from cache for faster response. For different queries, the system queries the database and then updates the cache accordingly. |
| 19 | System Messaging & Reliability | Auto Retry Payment Callback Handling via RabbitMQ | When the system fails to process a payment callback message (e.g., due to DB issue, service downtime), the message queue (RabbitMQ) automatically retries the handling according to configured retry policies (e.g., exponential backoff, dead-letter queue) until it succeeds or is moved to error handling. |
| 20 | System Security & Stability | Apply Rate Limiting on API Requests | The system applies rate limiting on selected APIs (e.g., login, payment callback, sync) to prevent abuse, brute force attacks, or excessive traffic from a single client. Limits can be based on IP address, API key, or user. |
| 21 | System Resilience & Availability | Fallback to Memory Cache & DB if Redis Fails | When Redis is unavailable (e.g., disconnected, crashed), the system automatically switches to in-memory caching (MemoryCache) and direct database queries to ensure continuous operation without crashing or blocking. |
| 22 | System Resilience & Availability | Auto Reconnect on WebSocket Disconnection | When the realtime connection (e.g., SignalR or WebSocket) is lost due to network issues or server restart, the client (e.g., kiosk or admin panel) will automatically attempt to reconnect periodically and resume communication without requiring user intervention. |
| 23 | Kiosk Automation | Execute Workflow Based on Synced Data | After receiving a ice cream cup order, the kiosk reads the pre-synced workflow (including steps, device actions) and automatically activates the ice cream cup-making process based on the defined workflow. |
| 24 | Workflow Observer | Monitor Workflow Execution | Continuously monitors the execution progress of ice cream cup-making workflows. It listens to changing events of workflow ‘s steps, compares them with predefined conditions, and decides next actions.  |
| 25 | Step Observer | Monitor step result from devices | Listens for step result updates pushed from individual devices. When a device completes or fails a step, it sends a state message. The observer captures this change and marks the step as “observed”.  |
| 26 | Device Status Watcher | Monitor and Update Device Detail Status | Monitors the real-time operational status of connected devices. Devices periodically push status reports every minute.  |

#### ***3.1.5 Entity Relationship Diagram***

![][image5]

**Entities Description**

| \# | Entity | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | Account | Stores account credentials and identity information for both organization and store users. |
| 2 | Organization | Represents a company or business unit managing one or multiple stores. |
| 3 | Store | Physical or virtual store location under an organization, equipped with kiosks. |
| 4 | Kiosk | A vending or ice cream machine unit linked to a store that processes ice cream cup workflows. |
| 5 | KioskVersion | Contains versioning information and supported configuration for kiosks. |
| 6 | Menu | Defines the available product selection offered by a store or kiosk. |
| 7 | Product | Represents ice cream cup items or recipes available for order. |
| 8 | ProductCategory | Groups products for easier management or display on UI. |
| 9 | Workflow | Defines as recipe or process flow to prepare a specific product. |
| 10 | Step | A step within a workflow to operate devices for specific ice cream cup-making actions. |
| 11 | Device | Represents physical components (e.g. pump, cooler) installed in kiosks. |
| 12 | DeviceModel | Template or specification for types of devices (e.g. brand, manufacturer). |
| 13 | DeviceType | Classifies devices by functionality (e.g. mixer, pump, cooler). |
| 14 | DeviceFunctions | Defines callable actions for a device (e.g. HeatWater, Dispense). |
| 15 | FunctionParameters | Parameters accepted by a function (e.g. temperature, volume). |
| 16 | Webhook | Stores webhook endpoints used for triggering actions from external systems. |
| 17 | Order | Stores customer purchase and payment transaction information. |
| 18 | OrderDetail | Line item per product in an order, with quantity and price. |
| 19 | Payment | Stores payment status and transaction information tied to orders. |
| 20 | SyncEvent | Tracks changes in data for synchronization with kiosks. |
| 21 | SyncTask | Job queue for delivering sync events to kiosks. |
| 22 | SystemConfig | Stores key-value configuration parameters applied globally in the system. |
| 23 | DeviceIngredient | The base ingredient of each device model |
| 24 | DeviceIngredientState | The real ingredient of each device working into a kiosk |
| 25 | ProductAttribute | The attributes combine to make the product |
| 26 | AttributeOption | The options of each attribute to make the product |

- Function description:  
  - Actors/Roles: System Admin, Organization Admin  
  - Purpose: The dashboard provides an overview of the system's business performance, customer behaviour, order statuses and kiosk health.  
  - Interface:  
    - Overview Cards:  total revenue, total kiosk, total organization, total store, growth rate, active account of organization.

  - Data Processing:  
    - Server count and calculate all then return for client.  
- Function trigger:  
  - Navigation path: Admin access the dashboard via the left sidebar by clicking the “Dashboard” menu item.

### **3.3 Order Management Screen** {#3.3-order-management-screen}

#### ***3.3.1 View list of orders***

- Function description:  
  - Actors/Roles:   
    - System Admin: Full access to all order data across the system.  
    - Organization Admin: Access limited to orders within their managed organization or kiosks.  
  - Purpose: This screen provides administrators with a comprehensive view of all customer orders in the system, including details such as status, payment method, and total amount.  
  - Interface:  
    - Table: Displays a structured, paginated list of all order with following columns:  
      - OrderId  
      - OrderType  
      - Payment Method  
      - Status  
      - Final Amount  
      - Order Time  
      - Action  
    - Optional UI Element:  
      - Search bar  
      - Filter dropdowns  
      - Pagination controls  
      - Column visibility configuration  
      - “Làm mới” (Refresh) button  
      - “Xuất dữ liệu” button  
  - Data Processing:  
    - Server returns for the client a  list of orders based on filter, search, sort and paging.  
- Function trigger:  
  - Navigation path: Admin access the table of list order  via the left sidebar by clicking the “Quản lý đơn hàng” menu item.  
  - Timing Frequency: Data is auto-refresh every 60 seconds, or manually via browser reload or clicking button “Làm mới”  
- Screen layout:

![][image7]

- Function details:  
  - Data & Validation:

| Data | Validations |
| :---- | :---- |
| OrderId | … |
| OrderType | … |
| PaymentMethod | … |
| OrderStatus | … |
| FinalAmount | … |

  - Functionalities: 

| Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Access order list | Admin accesses the screen and views a paginated table of orders. | If the API fails, an error message is displayed with a retry option. |
| Search by keyword | Admin searches using order ID or keywords and receives matching results. | If no results match the query, display “No orders found.” |
| Apply filters | Admin applies one or more filters and the result list updates accordingly. | If invalid filter input is provided or server error occurs, display a warning and keep previous results. |
| Sort columns | Admin clicks column headers to sort data in ascending or descending order. | If sorting fails (e.g., backend fails), fallback to unsorted data and notify the user. |
| Pagination navigation | Admin uses pagination controls to navigate between pages (e.g., next, previous). | If the requested page index is invalid or unavailable, reset to page 1 with a warning. |
| Manual refresh | Admin clicks “Làm mới” and the order list reloads with the latest data. | If refresh fails (e.g., network error), display an error and allow retry. |

#### ***3.3.1 View detail of an order***

- Function description:  
  - Actors/Roles:   
    - System Admin:Has full access to view the detailed information of any order in the system..  
    - Organization Admin: Can view order details only within their own organization or the kiosks they manage.  
  - Purpose: This screen allows administrators to view complete and structured details of a specific customer order. It provides critical information such as order ID, status, order type, payment method, financial breakdown (discounts, fees, VAT), and a list of ordered items. This enables transparency, order tracking, and verification for administrative tasks.

| Sort columns | Admin clicks column headers to sort data in ascending or descending organization. | If sorting fails (e.g., backend fails), fallback to unsorted data and notify the user. |
| Pagination navigation | Admin uses pagination controls to navigate between pages (e.g., next, previous). | If the requested page index is invalid or unavailable, reset to page 1 with a warning. |
| Manual refresh | Admin clicks “Làm mới” and the organization list reloads with the latest data. | If refresh fails (e.g., network error), display an error and allow retry. |

| Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Open creation modal | Admin clicks the “Thêm” (Add) button, and the creation modal appears with all input fields visible. | If the modal fails to load, show an error notification or fallback to the full-page creation screen. |
| Input organization info | Admin fills in fields such as name, code, tax ID, description, and status. | If any required field is missing or invalid, show inline validation error (e.g., red border \+ tooltip). |
| Input contact information | Admin enters a valid phone number and email address. | If an email or phone is incorrectly formatted, prevent form submission and display clear validation messages. |
| Upload logo | Admin uploads a JPG/PNG/GIF logo file (max 2MB) or pastes a logo URL. | If a file exceeds the size limit or has invalid format, show error and prevent submission. |
| Status selection | Admin selects organization status (e.g., Active, Inactive) from a dropdown list. | If status is null or outside expected enum, show “Invalid status” error and reject submission. |
| Submit creation | Admin clicks the “Tạo” (Create) button; frontend validates inputs and sends data to backend. | If submission fails (e.g., server error), display error toast and retain input state for retry. |
| Close modal | Admin presses ESC, clicks “×”, or clicks Hủy (Cancel) to close the modal. | If the modal fails to close due to UI issues, fallback with ESC key or trigger full-page reload. |

#### ***3.4.5 Delete an organization***

- Function description:  
  - Actors/Roles:   
    - System Admin: Has full permission to delete organizations.  
    - Organization Admin: No access to this feature.  
  - Purpose: This function allows a system administrator to immediately delete an organization from the system with a single action.  
  - Interface:  
    - The Delete option is located inside the “Hành động”  (Action) dropdown on the View List of Organizations screen.  
    - No confirmation modal is shown — clicking “Xóa” (Delete) will immediately trigger the delete operation.  
    - After deletion, the organization is removed from the list UI.  
  - Data Processing:  
    - A DELETE request is sent to the backend with the organization ID.  
    - The server performs the deletion (soft/hard based on implementation) and returns success or failure.  
    - The frontend updates the list by removing the deleted item.  
    - Error toast is displayed in case of API failure (e.g., 403, 500).  
- Function trigger:  
  - Navigation path: From the left sidebar, admin selects the “Xóa” button from the “Hành động” dropdown.

#### ***3.7.3 Create a product***

- Function description:  
  - Actors/Roles:   
    - System Admin: Can create products for all organizations.  
    - Organization Admin: Can create products only within their assigned organization.  
  - Purpose: This function allows administrators to create a new product with detailed attributes including name, type, size, pricing, status, and associated ingredients.  
  - Interface:  
    - Fields include:  
      - Product Image Upload  
      - Product Name  
      - Parent Product  
      - Size  
      - Product Type  
      - Status  
      - Price   
      - Active flag  
      - Category/Tag  
      - Description  
      - Product Ingredients Section	  
        - Each ingredient includes:   
          - Label  
          - Ingredient type  
          - Description  
          - Default quantity  
          - Display order  
          - Unit.  
    - Contact Information Section:  
      - Phone Number: Input for contact number.  
      - Address: Input for the physical address.  
    - Description Section:  
      - Free-text field for any store-related notes or comments.  
    - Action Button  
      - Modal close button “X”  
      - “Tạo” (Create): Submits the form to the backend.  
      - “Hủy” (Cancel): Closes modal without saving.  
  - Data Processing:  
    - When the admin submits the form, the frontend validates input data and sends it to the backend.  
    - Backend persists the new product and returns success/failure response.  
    - Upon success, modal closes and the product list is refreshed.  
- Function trigger:  
  - Navigation path: From the “Quản lý sản phẩm” screen, admin clicks the “Thêm” button.  
  - Modal Display: A modal opens, showing a form with input fields.  
- Screen layout:

![][image23]

- Function details:  
  - Data & Validation:

| Data | Validations |
| :---- | :---- |
| ProductId | Auto-generated by backend |
| Name | Required, max 255 characters |
| ParentProduct | Optional, must refer to existing product |
| Size | Optional, select from predefined options |
| ProductType | Required, Enum ("Cha", "Con") |
| Status | Required, Enum ("Đang bán", "Ngừng bán") |
| Price | Required, positive number, displayed in VND |
| IsActive | Boolean, required |
| Description | Optional, max 450 characters |
| Category | Optional, must match predefined categories |
| Image | Optional, must be JPG or PNG, max 2MB |
| Ingredient.Label | Optional, text |
| Ingredient.Type | Required, must be in IngredientType list |
| Ingredient.Description | Optional |
| Ingredient.DefaultQty | Required, numeric |
| Ingredient.Unit | Required, enum ("Grams", "Milliliters", etc.) |
| Ingredient.Order | Optional, numeric, defines ingredient sort order |
| CreatedDate | Auto-set by backend |

  - Functionalities: 

| Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Open creation modal | Admin clicks “Thêm”, modal opens for product entry. | If modal fails to open, show error notification. |
| Fill form | Admin enters product info including ingredients. | If required fields are missing, prevent submission and show error. |
| Upload image | Admin uploads JPG/PNG or provides URL. | If file size \> 2MB or wrong format, show error and reject upload. |
| Add ingredients | Admin adds multiple attributes (ingredient type, label, etc.). | If duplicate or invalid values, show inline warnings. |
| Submit creation | Click “Tạo” sends data to backend and closes modal on success. | If the backend returns an error (e.g. validation fails), show an inline error message. |
| Cancel/Close modal | Admin clicks “Hủy” to close modal without saving. | If modal fails to close, allow fallback via ESC. |

  - Business Rules:

#### ***3.7.5 Delete a product***

- Function description:  
  - Actors/Roles:   
    - System Admin: Has full access to delete any product in the system.  
    - Organization Admin: Can delete products within their assigned organization.  
  - Purpose: This function allows administrators to permanently delete a product from the system with a single action, helping maintain a clean and accurate product list.  
  - Interface:  
    - The **Delete** option is located inside the **"Hành động"** (Action) dropdown on the product list screen.  
    - No confirmation modal is shown — clicking **"Xóa"** will immediately trigger the deletion process and remove the product.  
    - The deleted product will disappear from the table after the operation.  
  - Data Processing:  
    - Frontend sends a DELETE request to the backend API with the product ID.  
    - Backend verifies permission, deletes product record, and returns success status.  
    - On success, frontend refreshes the list to remove the deleted product.  
    - Error toast is displayed in case of API failure (e.g., 403, 500).  
- Function trigger:  
  - Navigation path: From the sidebar, admin selects **“Quản lý sản phẩm”** to open the product management screen.  
- Layout: 

![][image25]

      - “Thêm” (Add) button

  - Data Processing:

    - The server returns a list of menus for the client based on filter, search, sort, and paging parameters.

- Function trigger:

  - Navigation path: Admin accesses the table of the list of menus via the left sidebar by clicking the “Quản lý menu” (Menu Management) menu item.

| Manual refresh | Admin clicks the “Làm mới” button to reload the menu list | If the reload fails, display a notification toast with a retry option |

      - Thao tác (Action \- e.g., delete product from menu)

    - Action Button:

      - “Cập nhật” (Update) button to open the edit modal.

#### ***3.8.3 Create a menu***

- Function description:

      - “Hủy” (Cancel): Closes the modal without saving

  - Data Processing:

    - When the admin submits the form, the frontend validates input data and sends it to the backend.

    - The backend persists the new menu and returns a success/failure response.

    - Upon success, the modal closes, and the menu list is refreshed.

- Function trigger:

  - Navigation path: From the “Quản lý menu” screen, the admin clicks the “Thêm” (Add) button.

  - Modal Display: A modal opens, showing a form with input fields for creating a new menu.

- Function trigger:

  - Navigation path: From the menu list (“Quản lý menu”), the admin clicks the “Hành động” (Action) button, then selects “Chỉnh sửa” (Edit).

  - Modal Display: The update modal opens with all fields pre-filled with the menu’s current data.

- Screen layout:

![][image29]

- Function details:

  - Data & Validation:

| Data | Validations |
| :---- | :---- |
| Name  | Required, text |
|  OrganizationId | Required, must be a valid ID from the organization list |
| Status  | Required, Enum ("Hoạt động" \- Active, "Không hoạt động" \- Inactive).  |
| Description  | Optional, max 450 characters |
| UpdatedDate | Auto-set by the backend |

| Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |

#### ***3.8.5 Delete a menu***

- Function description:

  - Actors/Roles: 

    - System Admin: Has full access to delete any menu in the system.

    - Organization Admin: Can delete menus within their assigned organization.

  - Purpose: This function allows administrators to permanently delete a menu from the system after confirming their intent in a separate dialog.

  - Interface:

    - The "Delete" option is located inside the "Hành động" (Action) dropdown.

    - Clicking “Xóa” (Delete) opens a confirmation modal.

    - The modal displays a warning: Bạn có chắc chắn muốn xóa menu "Menu Name"? Hành động này không thể hoàn tác. (Are you sure you want to delete the menu "Menu Name"? This action cannot be undone.)

    - The modal contains a “Hủy” (Cancel) button and a red “Xóa” (Delete) button to confirm.

  - Data Processing: 

    - After user confirmation, the frontend sends a DELETE request to the backend API with the menu ID.

    - The backend verifies permission, deletes the menu record, and returns a success status.

    - On success, the frontend refreshes the list to remove the deleted menu.

- Function trigger:

  - Navigation path: From the menu list, the admin clicks the “Hành động” (Action) button, then selects “Xóa” (Delete).

- Screen layout:

![][image30]

- Function details:

  - Data & Validation:

  - Functionalities: 

| Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Initiate deletion | Admin clicks "Xóa," and the confirmation modal appears | If the modal fails to open, show an error notification |
| Confirm deletion | Admin clicks the red "Xóa" button. The menu is deleted, the modal closes, and the list refreshes | If the API call fails, show an error toast, and the modal remains open or closes |
| Cancel deletion | Admin clicks "Hủy" or closes the modal. No action is taken, and the menu remains in the list | If the modal fails to close, allow Esc key fallback |

- Business Rules:

  * Deleting a menu only removes the menu entity and its associations with products. It does not delete the actual products from the system.

### **3.9 Category Management Screen** {#3.9-category-management-screen}

#### ***3.9.1 View list of categories***

- Function description:

  - Actors/Roles: System Admin / Organization Admin: Has full access to view the list of categories, as they are typically system-wide.

  - Purpose: This function allows administrators to view, search, and manage the list of all product categories available in the system.

  - Interface:

    - Table: Displays a structured, paginated list of all categories with the following columns:

      - Category ID (Mã danh mục)

      - Image (Hình ảnh)

      - Category Name (Tên danh mục)

      - Description (Mô tả)

      - Order (Thứ tự)

      - Status (Trạng thái)

      - Action (Hành động)

    - Optional UI Element:

      - Search bar (Tìm kiếm danh mục...)

      - Filter dropdowns (Trạng thái \- Status)

      - Pagination controls

      - Column visibility configuration (Cột \- Columns)

      - Refresh button (Làm mới)

      - Export data button (Xuất dữ liệu)

      - Add button (Thêm)

  - Data Processing:

    - The client sends requests with filter, search, sort, and paging parameters to the server.

    - The server responds with a paginated list of category data.

- Function trigger:

  - Navigation path: The administrator accesses the category list by clicking the “Quản lý danh mục” (Category Management) item in the sidebar menu.

![][image31]

- Function details:

| Data | Validations |
| :---- | :---- |

| Name  | Required, text |
| Description  | Optional, text |
| Order  | Required, integer, used for sorting |
| Status  | Required, Enum ("Hoạt động" \- Active, "Không hoạt động" \- Inactive) |

  - Functionalities: 

| Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |

| Search by keyword | Admin types a category name into the search bar to filter results | If no results are found, display a message like "No categories found. |
| Apply filters | Admin filters the list by category status | If the filter is invalid, show a warning and revert to the previous state |
|  Pagination navigation | Admin uses pagination controls to navigate through pages | If a requested page is out of range, reset to page 1 |

- Business Rules:

  * The Order column dictates the default display sequence of categories in other parts of the application (e.g., on a customer-facing website).

  - 

  - Function trigger:

    - Navigation path: From the “Quản lý danh mục” screen, the administrator clicks the “Thêm” (Add) button.

    - Modal Display: A modal opens with an empty form for creating a new category.

![][image33]

- Function details:

  - Data & Validation:

| Data | Validations |
| :---- | :---- |
| Image  | Optional, must be a valid image file |
|  Name  | Required, max 255 characters. Must be unique |
| DisplayOrder | Required, must be a positive integer |
| Order  | Optional, text |
| Status  | Enum ("Hoạt động" \- Active, "Không hoạt động" \- Inactive) |
| Description  | Optional, text. |

  - Functionalities: 

| Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Open creation modal | Admin clicks “Thêm”, and the modal opens with a blank form | If the modal fails to open, show an error notification |
|  Fill form | Admin enters category information | If required fields are missing, prevent submission and show inline validation errors |
| Add image | Admin uploads an image file or provides a URL |  If the file format/size is invalid or the URL is malformed, show an error message |
| Submit creation | Clicking “Tạo” sends data to the backend. On success, the modal closes and the list refreshes | If the backend returns an error (e.g., name not unique), show an informative error message in the modal. |
| Cancel/Close modall | Admin clicks “Hủy” or presses Esc to close the modal | If the modal fails to close, allow fallback closure |

- Business Rules:

  * The category Name must be unique across all categories.

  * The Order value should ideally be unique to ensure a predictable sort order.

#### ***3.9.4 Update a category***

- Function description:

  - Actors/Roles: System Admin / Organization Admin can edit any existing category.

  - Purpose:   This function allows administrators to modify the details of an existing product category.

  - Interface:

    - Editable Fields Section:

      - Image Upload (Tải lên hình ảnh) / Image URL (URL hình ảnh) with a delete option.

      - Category Name (Tên Danh Mục)

      - Order (Thứ tự) (Inferred from list/detail view)

      - Status (Trạng thái)

      - Description (Mô tả)

    - Action Button:

      - Modal close button “X”.

      - “Cập nhật” (Update): Saves the changes.

      - “Hủy” (Cancel): Closes the modal without saving.

  - Data Processing:

    - The frontend fetches the current category data and pre-fills the form. Upon submission, it sends the updated data to the backend via a PUT request.

  - Function trigger:

    - Navigation path: From the category list, the administrator clicks the “Hành động” (Action) button, then selects “Chỉnh sửa” (Edit).

    - Modal Display: The update modal opens with all fields pre-filled with the category’s current data.

- Screen layout:

![][image34]

- Function details:

  - Data & Validation:

| Data | Validations |
| :---- | :---- |
| Image  | Optional, must be a valid image file |
|  Name  | Required, max 255 characters. Must be unique |
| DisplayOrder | Required, must be a positive integer |
| Order  | Optional, text |
| Status  | Enum ("Hoạt động" \- Active, "Không hoạt động" \- Inactive) |
| Description  | Optional, text. |

  - Functionalities: 

| Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Open edit modal | Admin clicks “Chỉnh sửa,” and the modal opens with pre-filled data | If the modal fails to open or fetch data, show an error. |
|  Modify information  | Admin edits fields like name, order, etc., and submits | If required fields are empty, show an inline validation error |
| Change image | Admin uploads a new image, provides a new URL, or deletes the existing image | If the new image/URL is invalid, show a validation error. |
| Submit update | The backend updates the data and returns success. The modal closes, and the list refreshes | If the backend returns an error, display the message and keep the modal open |
| Cancel/Close modal  | Admin clicks “Hủy” or presses Esc to close without saving | If the modal is stuck, allow Esc key fallback |

- Business Rules:

  * The updated category Name must not conflict with any other existing category name.

#### ***3.9.5 Delete a category***

- Function description:

  - Actors/Roles: System Admin / Organization Admin can delete any category.

  - Purpose:   This function allows administrators to permanently remove a category from the system after confirmation.

  - Interface:

    - The "Delete" option is located inside the "Hành động" (Action) dropdown.

    - Clicking “Xóa” (Delete) opens a confirmation modal.

    - The modal displays a warning: Bạn có chắc chắn muốn xóa danh mục "\[Category Name\]"? Hành động này không thể hoàn tác. (Are you sure you want to delete the category "\[Category Name\]"? This action cannot be undone.)

    - The modal contains a “Hủy” (Cancel) button and a red “Xóa” (Delete) button.

  - Data Processing:

    - Upon confirmation, the frontend sends a DELETE request with the category ID to the backend.

    - The backend validates permissions, deletes the category, and returns a success response.

  - Function trigger:

    - Navigation path: From the category list, the administrator clicks the “Hành động” (Action) button, then selects “Xóa” (Delete).

- Screen layout:

![][image35]

- Function details:

  - Data & Validation:

  - Functionalities: 

| Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Initiate deletion | Admin clicks "Xóa," and the confirmation modal appears. |  If the modal fails to open, show an error. |
| Confirm deletion | Admin clicks the red "Xóa" button. The category is deleted, the modal closes, and the list refreshes. | If the API call fails (e.g., category is in use), show an error toast and keep the user on the page. |
| Cancel deletion | Admin clicks "Hủy" or closes the modal. No action is taken | If the modal fails to close, allow Esc key fallback. |

- Business Rules:

  * The system should prevent the deletion of a category if it is currently associated with one or more products. An appropriate error message should be displayed to the user in this case.

|  Fill form | Admin enters a unique name, an optional description, and selects a status | If the required "Name" field is empty, prevent submission and show an inline validation error. |
| Submit creation | Clicking “Tạo” sends data to the backend. On success, the modal closes, and the list refreshes |  If the backend returns an error (e.g., name is not unique), show an informative error message in the modall |
| Cancel/Close modal | Admin clicks “Hủy” or presses Esc to close the modal | If the modal fails to close, allow fallback closure via the Esc key. |

- Business Rules:The ingredient type Name must be unique.

  - Data Processing:

    - Navigation path: From the ingredient type list, the administrator clicks the “Hành động” (Action) button, then selects “Chỉnh sửa” (Edit).

  - Functionalities: 

| Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |

#### ***3.11.5 Delete an ingredient type***

- Function description:

  - Actors/Roles: System Admin: Can delete any ingredient type

  - Purpose:   This function allows an administrator to permanently remove an ingredient type from the system after confirmation

  - Interfaces:

    - The "Delete" option is located inside the "Hành động" (Action) dropdown.

    - Clicking “Xóa” (Delete) opens a confirmation modal.

    - The modal displays a warning: Bạn có chắc chắn muốn xóa loại nguyên liệu "\[Name\]"? Hành động này không thể hoàn tác. (Are you sure you want to delete the ingredient type "\[Name\]"? This action cannot be undone.)

    - The modal contains a “Hủy” (Cancel) button and a red “Xóa” (Delete) button.

  - Data Processing:

    - Upon confirmation, the frontend sends a DELETE request with the ingredient type ID to the backend.

    - The backend validates permissions, deletes the record, and returns a success response.

  - Function trigger:

    - Navigation path: From the ingredient type list, the administrator clicks the “Hành động” (Action) button, then selects “Xóa” (Delete).

- Screen layout:

![][image45]

- Function details:

  - Data & Validation:

  - Functionalities: 

| Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Initiate deletion | Admin clicks "Xóa," and the confirmation modal appears | If the modal fails to open, show an error. |
| Confirm deletion | Admin clicks the red "Xóa" button. The ingredient type is deleted, the modal closes, and the list refreshes | If the API call fails (e.g., type is in use), show an error toast and keep the user on the page. |
|  Cancel deletion | Admin clicks "Hủy" or closes the modal. No action is taken | If the modal fails to close, allow Esc key fallback. |

- Business Rules: The system should prevent the deletion of an ingredient type if it is currently associated with any product's recipe. An appropriate error message should be displayed.

### **3.12 Sync Event Management Screen** {#3.12-sync-event-management-screen}

#### ***3.12.1 View list of sync events***

- Function description:

  - Actors/Roles:  System Admin: Has full access to view system-level synchronization logs.

  - Purpose:  This function allows administrators to monitor and audit system-generated synchronization events. It serves as a log for debugging data consistency issues between different system components or services.

  - Interface:

    - Table: Displays a structured, paginated list of all sync events with the following columns:

      - Event ID (Mã sự kiện)

      - Event Type (Loại sự kiện)

      - Entity Type (Loại thực thể)

      - Created Date (Ngày tạo)

      - Number of Tasks (Số tác vụ)

      - Action (Hành động)

    - Optional UI Element:

      - Search bar (Tìm kiếm theo mã thực thể...)

      - Filter dropdown (Loại sự kiện \- Event Type)

      - Pagination controls

      - Column visibility configuration (Cột \- Columns)

      - Refresh button (Làm mới)

      - Export data button (Xuất dữ liệu)

  - Data Processing:

    - The client sends requests with filter, search, and paging parameters to the server.

    - The server responds with a paginated list of sync event log data.

  - Function trigger:

    - Navigation path: The administrator accesses the list by clicking the “Quản lý đồng bộ event” (Sync Event Management) item in the sidebar menu.

    - Timing Frequency: Data is re-fetched on page load, manual refresh, or periodically to show the latest events.

- Screen layout:

  ![][image46]  
  \- Function details:

  - Data & Validation:

| EventId  | Auto-generated, unique identifier |
| :---- | :---- |
|  EventType  | Required, Enum |
| EntityType  | Required, text, represents the type of data being synced |
| CreatedDate  | Auto-set by the system, displayed with time and date |
| TaskCount  | Integer representing the number of sync tasks associated with this event |

  - Functionalities: 

| Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Access event list | Admin opens the screen and views the paginated log table | f the API fails, show an error message with a retry option |
|  Search by keyword | Admin types an entity ID into the search bar to find related sync events | f no results are found, display a message like "No events found." |
| Apply filters | Admin filters the list by Loại sự kiện (Event Type | If the filter is invalid, show a warning and revert to the previous state |
| Pagination navigation | Admin uses pagination controls to navigate through pages |  If a requested page is out of range, reset to page 1 |

- Business Rules: This screen is a read-only log. Events are generated automatically by the system and cannot be created, updated, or deleted by the user from this interface.

- The Hành động (Action) column is expected to only contain an option to "View Detail".

#### ***3.12.2 View detail of a sync event***

- Function description:

  - Actors/Roles: System Admin: Can view the detailed breakdown of any sync event.

  - Purpose:   This function provides a detailed, read-only view of a specific sync event, including the associated entity IDs and the status of the synchronization tasks.

  - Interface:

    - Header Section: Displays the full Event ID (Mã sự kiện) and the event's creation timestamp.

    - Event Information Section (

      - Event Type (Loại sự kiện)

      - Entity Type (Loại thực thể)

      - Entity ID (Mã thực thể): The ID of the specific record that triggered the event.

    - 

    - Task List Section (

      - Lists the individual sync task IDs associated with the event.

      - Displays the status of each task with a badge (e.g., Chưa đồng bộ \- Not Synced).

    - 

    - Action Button:

      - Modal close button "X".

  - Data Processing:

    - The frontend sends the event ID to the backend when the detail view is triggered.

    - The backend returns the full data object for that specific event, including its related tasks.

  - Function trigger:

    - Navigation path: From the “Quản lý sự kiện đồng bộ” screen, the administrator clicks the “Hành động” (Action) button on a specific row, then selects "View Detail".

    - Modal Display: A modal overlay appears with the read-only event information.

- Screen layout:

![][image47]

\- Function details:

- Data & Validation:

| EventId  | Auto-generated, unique identifier |
| :---- | :---- |
|  EventType  | Required, Enum |
| EntityType  | Required, text, represents the type of data being synced |
| EntityId  | A unique identifier (UUID) for the source record |
| TaskId  | A unique identifier (UUID) for the sync task |
| TaskStatus  | Enum |

  - Functionalities: 

| Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Open detail modal | Admin clicks to view details, and the modal opens showing the full event information | If the event data cannot be fetched, show an error message |
| View information | All fields, including IDs and types, are clearly displayed. The status of each sync task is visible | If data is missing from the backend response, corresponding fields may be empty or show a placeholder |
|  Close modal |  Admin clicks the “×” button or presses Esc to close the modal | If the modal fails to close, allow Esc key as a fallback |

- Business Rules: 

  - All information in this view is read-only and intended for diagnostic purposes.

  - The status badge on each task (Chưa đồng bộ, etc.) is a critical indicator for debugging the synchronization process.

### **3.13 Sync Task Management Screen** {#3.13-sync-task-management-screen}

#### ***3.13.1 View list of sync tasks***

- Function description:

  - Actors/Roles:  System Admin: Has full access to view system-level synchronization tasks.

  - Purpose: This function allows administrators to monitor the status of individual synchronization tasks. Each task represents an attempt to sync a specific event (like a data change) to a target entity (like a kiosk). This screen is crucial for diagnosing issues at a granular level.

  - Interface:

    - Table: Displays a structured, paginated list of all sync tasks with the following columns:

      - Task ID (Mã tác vụ)

      - Kiosk ID (Mã kiosk)

      - Created Date (Ngày tạo)

      - Status (Trạng thái)

      - Action (Hành động)

    - Optional UI Element:

      - Search bar (Tìm kiếm theo mã kiosk...)

      - Filter dropdown (Trạng thái \- Status)

      - Pagination controls

      - Column visibility configuration (Cột \- Columns)

      - Refresh button (Làm mới)

      - Export data button (Xuất dữ liệu)

  - Data Processing:

    - The client sends requests with filter, search, and paging parameters to the server.

    - The server responds with a paginated list of sync task data.

  - Function trigger:

    - Navigation path: The administrator accesses the list by clicking the “Quản lý đồng bộ task” (Sync Task Management) item in the sidebar menu.

    - Timing Frequency: Data is re-fetched on page load, manual refresh, or periodically to show the latest task statuses.

- Screen layout:

![][image48]

\- Function details:

- Data & Validation:

| TaskId  | Auto-generated, unique identifier |
| :---- | :---- |
|  KioskId  | The unique identifier (UUID) of the target kiosk for the sync |
| CreatedDate  | The date the task was created. Displayed as "N/A" if not available |
| Status  | Required, Enum |

  - Functionalities: 

| Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Access task list | Admin opens the screen and views the paginated log table | If the API fails, show an error message with a retry option. |
|  Search by keyword | Admin types a Kiosk ID into the search bar to find all tasks related to that kiosk | If no results are found, display a message like "No tasks found." |
| Apply filters | Admin filters the list by Trạng thái (Status). |  If the filter is invalid, show a warning and revert to the previous state |
| Pagination navigation | Admin uses pagination controls to navigate through pages |  If a requested page is out of range, reset to page 1 |

- Business Rules:

  - This screen is a read-only log. Tasks are generated and updated automatically by the system and cannot be manually changed by the user.

  - The Ngày tạo (Created Date) being "N/A" might indicate a data issue or that the timestamp is not a primary concern for this view.

![][image49]

\- Function details:

- Data & Validation:

#### ***3.15.3 Create a device model***

- Function description:  
  - Actors/Roles:   
    - System Admin: Can create any device model in the system.  
    - Organization Admin: No access to this feature.  
  - Purpose: This function allows authorized users to register a new device model, define its core specifications (name, type, manufacturer), and configure its supported functions and ingredient components. This enables centralized control and modular usage across various kiosks.  
  - Interface:  
    - Basic Information Section:  
      - Device Model Name  
      - Manufacturer  
      - Device Type  
      - Status  
    - Device Function Section:  
      - List of functions:  
        - Function Name  
        - Label  
        - Status  
        - Parameters:  
          - Name  
          - Type   
          - Options  
          - Default Value  
          - Description  
    - Device Ingredient Section:  
      - List of ingredients used by this model:  
        - Label  
        - Ingredient Type  
        - Min / Max capacity  
        - Warning Percentage  
        - Unit  
        - Status  
        - Is Main  
        - Is Refillable  
        - Optional: Binding to device function and mapping with specific parameters (selection value, target parameter)  
    - Action Button  
      - Modal close button “X”  
      - “Tạo” (Create): Submits the form to the backend.  
      - “Hủy” (Cancel): Closes modal without saving.  
      - “Thêm chức năng” (Add function)  
      - “Thêm tham số” (Add parameter)  
      - “Thêm nguyên liệu” (Add ingredient)  
  - Data Processing:  
    - When the admin submits the form, the frontend validates input data and sends it to the backend.  
    - Backend persists the new product and returns success/failure response.  
    - Upon success, modal closes and the list is refreshed.  
- Function trigger:  
  - Navigation path: From the “Quản lí mẫu thiết bị” screen, admin clicks the "Thêm" (Add) button in the top-right corner.  
  - Modal Display: A modal opens, showing a form with input fields.  
- Screen layout:

![][image57]

- Function details:  
  - Data & Validation:

| Data | Validations |
| :---- | :---- |
| DeviceModelName | Required, unique, max 255 chars |
| Manufacturer | Required, max 255 chars |
| DeviceTypeId | Required, must match an existing type |
| Status | Optional, default to “Active” |
| Functions\[\] | Optional, but each function must be valid if added |
| Function.Name | Required, max 255 chars |
| Function.Label | Optional, max 255 chars |
| Function.Status | Must be “Active” or “Inactive” |
| Parameters\[\] | Optional; each must have valid name/type |
| Parameter.Name | Required, unique within function |
| Parameter.Type | Required, must be supported (Text, Number, Enum, etc.) |
| Parameter.Default | Required, must match type |
| Parameter.Choices\[\] | Optional for Enum/Text types only |
| Parameter.Description | Optional, max 450 chars |
| Ingredients\[\] | Optional; if added must include full mapping |
| Ingredient.Label | Required, max 255 chars |
| Ingredient.TypeId | Required, must match valid ingredient type |
| Ingredient.MinCapacity | Must be ≥ 0 |
| Ingredient.MaxCapacity | Must be \> MinCapacity |
| Ingredient.WarningPercent | Must be between 0 and 100 |
| Ingredient.Unit | Required, from pre-defined enum |
| Ingredient.IsMain | Boolean |
| Ingredient.IsRefillable | Boolean |
| Ingredient.FunctionMappingName | Optional, must match existing function |
| Ingredient.ParameterName | Optional, must match parameter in the mapped function |
| Ingredient.ParameterValue | Optional, string |
| Ingredient.ParameterTarget | Optional, for target result parameter |

  - Functionalities: 

| Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Open create modal | Admin opens “Create Device Model” modal | If modal fails to open, show toast message |
| Input base info | Admin fills name, type, manufacturer | If required fields missing, show red validation |
| Add function | Admin adds function and enters parameters | If param missing or invalid, highlight in red |
| Add ingredient | Admin maps ingredients with values and function links | If min greater than max capacity, show validation error |
| Submit form | All fields pass validation  new model saved | If any validation fails, block submission and scroll to error |
| Cancel/Close modal | Admin clicks “Hủy” to close modal without saving. | If modal fails to close, allow fallback via ESC. |

  - Business Rules:

#### ***3.15.5 Delete a device model***

- Function description:  
  - Actors/Roles:   
    - System Admin: Has full access to delete any device model across the entire system..  
    - Organization Admin: No access to this feature.  
  - Purpose: This function enables users to manage and oversee all registered device models (e.g., pump model, robot model, tablet model, etc.) used within the automated ice cream vending system. It helps ensure visibility over model versions, manufacturers, types, and operational status.  
  - Interface:  
    - The Delete option is located inside the "Hành động" (Action) dropdown on the device model list screen.  
    - A confirmation modal is shon — clicking "Xác nhận" will immediately trigger the deletion process and remove the device.  
    - The deleted device model will disappear from the table after the operation.  
  - Data Processing:  
    - Frontend sends a DELETE request to the backend API with the device model ID.  
    - Backend verifies permission, deletes device model record, and returns success status.  
    - On success, frontend refreshes the list to remove the deleted device model.  
    - Error toast is displayed in case of API failure (e.g., 403, 500).  
- Function trigger:  
  - Navigation path: From the sidebar, admin selects "Quản lý mẫu thiết bị", clicks the "⋯" action button on a device row, and chooses "Xoá" to trigger the confirmation modal.  
- Layout: 

![][image59]

#### ***3.19.3 Create a kiosk type***

- Function description:  
  - Actors/Roles:   
    - System Admin: Allowed to create new kiosk types across the system.

  - Purpose: This function allows system administrators to create and register a new kiosk type, supporting better classification and management of kiosk deployments.  
  - Interface:  
    - Fields include:  
      - Kiosk Type Name  
      - Status  
      - Description  
    - Action Button  
      - Modal close button “X”  
      - “Tạo” (Create): Submits the form to the backend.  
      - “Hủy” (Cancel): Closes modal without saving.  
  - Data Processing:  
    - When the admin submits the form, the frontend validates input data and sends it to the backend.  
    - Backend persists the new device type and returns success/failure response.  
    - Upon success, modal closes and the list is refreshed.  
- Function trigger:  
  - Navigation path: From the “Quản lý loại kiosk” screen, admin clicks the "Thêm" (Add) button in the top-right corner.

- Function details:

| Field | Validation Rules |
| :---- | :---- |

| Status | Required, must be either “Hoạt động” or “Không hoạt động” |
| Description | Optional, max 450 characters |

  - Functionalities: 

| Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Open create modal | Admin clicks “Thêm”, modal appears with empty fields | Modal fails to open → show retry message |
| Fill form & submit | Admin fills valid data and clicks “Tạo” → kiosk type is created successfully | Backend error → show inline error or toast notification |
| Field validation | Required fields missing → disable “Tạo” and show inline error | Input exceeds character limit → show validation message |
| Submit creation | Click “Tạo” sends data to backend and closes modal on success. | If the backend returns an error (e.g. validation fails), show an inline error message. |
| Cancel/Close modal | Admin clicks “Hủy” to close modal without saving. | If modal fails to close, allow fallback via ESC. |

- Function description:

    - Error toast is displayed in case of API failure (e.g., 403, 500).

| :---- | :---- |

| Name | Optional, string, max length 100 |
| Description | Optional, string, max length 300 |
| KioskVersionId | Optional, string, max length 50 |
| Type | Required, must match enum EWorkflowType |
| Steps | Optional, array of valid StepNestedDto |
| Steps\[\].Name | Required, string, max length 100 |
| Steps\[\].Type | Required, string, max length 450 |
| Steps\[\].DeviceModelId | Required, string |
| Steps\[\].MaxRetries | Optional, integer ≥ 0 |

| Steps\[\].Parameters | Optional, string, max length 500, must be valid JSON |
| Steps\[\].StepCode | Optional, string, max length 50 |
| Steps\[\].CallbackStepCode | Optional, string, max length 50 |
| Steps\[\].Conditions | Optional, array of valid StepConditionDto |
| Steps\[\].Conditions\[\].Name | Required, must match enum EConditionName, max length 50 |
| Steps\[\].Conditions\[\].Description | Optional, string, max length 450 |
| Steps\[\].Conditions\[\].Expression | Required, must contain valid left, operator, and right |
| Expression.Left.Type | Required, must match enum EExpressionType |
| Expression.Left.Value | Required, type depends on selected type (e.g., string, int) |
| Expression.Operator | Required, must match enum EOperation (Equal, NotEqual, \>, \<, etc.) |
| Expression.Right.Type | Required, must match enum EExpressionType |
| Expression.Right.Value | Required, type depends on selected type (e.g., string, int) |

  - Functionalities: 

| Function | Normal Case | Abnormal Case |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Open create workflow page | UI loads, default canvas shown | Server not connected → show offline error |
| Add new step | Step added to canvas and step list | If duplicate sequence, show error |
| Edit step | Data saved to local state | If missing required fields, show inline validation |
| Add condition | Expression builder opens, fields saved | Invalid expression (e.g. missing operand) → show error |
| Enter parameters | JSON/Visual input allowed | Invalid JSON format → validation failed |
| Submit workflow | Backend returns success, redirect | Backend failure → toast \+ retry option |
| Cancel | Return to list | N/A |

  - Data & Validation:  
    | Field | Validation |  
    | :--- | :--- |  
    | File | Required, format must be .lua or .xml, size < 5MB. |  
    | ProgramName | Required, max 100 chars, unique. |  
    | TargetModel | Required, must select from active device models. |  
  - Functionalities:  
    | Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |  
    | :--- | :--- | :--- |  
    | Submit file | Uploads file, computes checksum, creates draft artifact. | Invalid format -> show MSG10; upload fails -> show network error. |  

#### ***3.21.4 Publish / Retire robot program artifact***

- Function description:  
  - Actors/Roles: System Admin  
  - Purpose: Transition artifact status to "Published" (making it deployable) or "Retired" (preventing new bindings).  
- Function trigger: Action menu -> Click "Công bố" or "Thu hồi".  
- Function details:  
  - Functionalities:  
    | Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |  
    | :--- | :--- | :--- |  
    | Publish artifact | Status changes to Published; ready for configuration releases. | Fails if checksum is missing. |  
    | Retire artifact | Status changes to Retired. | Fails if artifact is bound to active release. |  


### **3.22 Telemetry and Realtime Monitoring Screen**

Provides live diagnostic monitoring of hardware controllers, sensors, emergency states, and network health.

#### ***3.22.1 View kiosk realtime status monitor***

- Function description:  
  - Actors/Roles: System Admin, Organization Admin, Maintenance Staff  
  - Purpose: Monitor connection states, cpu/disk telemetry, and robot runtime states.  
  - Interface: Status indicator panels (Green: Online, Red: Offline), Gauge charts for CPU/Memory/Disk percentage, active execution queue table.  
  - Data Processing: Aggregates real-time SignalR notifications from edge gateways.  
- Function trigger: Sidebar -> "Giám sát thời gian thực".  
- Screen layout:  
*(Diagram/Image skipped)*  
- Function details:  
  - Data & Validation:  
    | Field | Validation |  
    | :--- | :--- |  
    | KioskId | Must point to a valid active kiosk. |  
  - Functionalities:  
    | Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |  
    | :--- | :--- | :--- |  
    | Stream metrics | Gauge components update every 5 seconds. | Connection lost -> show reconnection spinner. |  

#### ***3.22.2 View sensor telemetry logs***

- Function description:  
  - Actors/Roles: System Admin, Maintenance Staff  
  - Purpose: Inspect temperature, door state, and safety sensors histories.  
  - Interface: Time-series charts showing temperature fluctuations; log history for cabinet door events.  
- Function details:  
  - Data & Validation:  
    | Field | Validation |  
    | :--- | :--- |  
    | SensorType | Temperature, DoorState, EmergencyStop. |  
  - Functionalities:  
    | Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |  
    | :--- | :--- | :--- |  
    | Load history | Loads historical metrics chart. | No records found -> show blank chart. |  

#### ***3.22.3 View robot task status queue***

- Function description:  
  - Actors/Roles: System Admin, Org Admin  
  - Purpose: Monitor execution queues of the robot arm.  
  - Interface: Chronological list showing Order ID, Command Type, Current Step, Step Duration, Status (Idle, Running, Completed, Faulted).  
- Function details:  
  - Functionalities:  
    | Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |  
    | :--- | :--- | :--- |  
    | Monitor queue | Steps change state in real-time as robot executes Lua script. | Robot faults -> highlights row in red, raises Alert automatically. |

#### ***3.23.1 View dispenser stock levels***

Manages alerts raised by system events and maps out maintenance operations.

#### ***3.24.1 View active alerts list***

- Function description:  
  - Actors/Roles: System Admin, Org Admin, Maintenance Staff  
  - Purpose: Monitor system warning events (e.g. Dispenser empty, Robot collision, Gateway offline).  
  - Interface: Log grid of alerts with filter panels. Columns: Severity (Critical, Warning), Title, Source, Status, Raised At.

- Function trigger: Sidebar -> "Cảnh báo & Bảo trì".  
- Screen layout:  
*(Diagram/Image skipped)*  
- Function details:

    | Field | Validation |

  - Functionalities:  
    | Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |  
    | :--- | :--- | :--- |  
    | Display alerts | Shows active alerts grouped by severity. | Server disconnect -> alert log display fails. |  

#### ***3.24.2 Acknowledge and resolve alerts***

- Function description:  
  - Actors/Roles: Maintenance Staff, Org Admin

    | Field | Validation |

    | ResolutionNotes | Required, max 500 chars. |  
  - Functionalities:  
    | Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |  
    | :--- | :--- | :--- |  
    | Submit resolution | Alert status transitions to Resolved; timestamp recorded. | Empty notes -> show MSG02 inline validation. |  

#### ***3.24.3 View maintenance tickets list***

- Function description: Browse ticket history logs representing hardware replacement or repair events.

- Function description:  
  - Actors/Roles: Org Admin, Store Manager

  - Interface: Ticket Form (Title, Kiosk, Description, Severity, Assignee).  
- Function details:

    | Field | Validation |

    | Description | Required, max 1000 chars. |  
  - Functionalities:  
    | Function | Normal Cases | Abnormal Cases |  
    | :--- | :--- | :--- |  
    | Submit Ticket | Ticket entry is inserted in `MaintenanceTickets`; status = Open. | Validation error -> reject submit and notify. |  

#### ***3.24.5 Update maintenance ticket status***

- Function description: Progress ticket status through Open -> In-Progress -> Resolved.

## **4\. Non-Functional Requirements** {#4.-non-functional-requirements}

### **4.1 External Interfaces** {#4.1-external-interfaces}

* The system provides RESTful APIs for integration with external services such as payment gateways and notification systems.  
* ice cream kiosks connect to the central server via secure HTTPS protocols to ensure data integrity and confidentiality.  
* Admin dashboards interact with backend services through authenticated API calls for real-time monitoring and control.

### **4.2 Quality Attributes** {#4.2-quality-attributes}

#### ***4.2.1 Usability*** 

* Dashboard provides a clear overview of all kiosks and their current statuses.  
* Filtering and sorting options allow quick access to specific kiosk/device information.  
* Designed for ease of use by customers at kiosks.  
* Minimal input required to place and complete an order.

#### ***4.2.2 Reliability*** 

* The system performs consistently under expected conditions.  
*  Retry mechanisms for failed actions.  
* Regular monitoring to detect and resolve issues proactively.

#### ***4.2.3 Performance***

* Real-time communication between frontend and backend.

* Fast response time for admin operations.

* Low latency for user interactions on the kiosk.

#### ***4.2.4 Security***

* #### All data transmissions are encrypted using HTTPS. 

* #### Payment processing follows secure protocols. 

* #### Role-based access control for all admin and system actions. 

#### ***4.2.5 Scalability***

* #### Easy to onboard new kiosks and organizations. 

* #### Modular architecture for expanding features. 

* #### Supports increasing user load without degrading performance.

## **5\. Requirement Appendix**

### **5.1 Business Rules** {#5.1-business-rules}

| ID | Rule Definition |
| ----- | ----- |
| BR-01 | An order can only be processed if all required devices are in the “IDLE” state. |
| BR-02 | Each kiosk can only process one product at a time, following a First-In, First-Out (FIFO) queue. |
| BR-03 | Only the System Admin is allowed to manage workflows. |
| BR-04 | Each order can contain a maximum of two products. |
| BR-05 | Orders must be successfully paid before being added to the processing queue. |
| BR-06 | A QR code will automatically expire after 2 minutes if not scanned. |
| BR-07 |  The kiosk system requires an active internet connection to function properly. |
| BR-08 | Each store must belong to exactly one organization. |
| BR-09 | A workflow cannot be deleted if it is currently active on any product. |
| BR-10 | A kiosk version cannot be deleted if any active kiosk instance is using it. |
| BR-11 | Each kiosk must have 2 ordering apps and 2 cup dispensers |
| BR-12 | Only the System Admin is allowed to synchronize workflows and devices to kiosks. |
| BR-13 | The order can not be canceled after payment. |
| BR-14 | The kiosk features two ice cream cup-serving stations: Dispenser container slots. |

### **5.2 Common Requirements**

The system must update the device's status in real time, at a minimum frequency of 30 minutes.

The Android application only uses Vietnamese as the primary language.

### **5.3 Application Messages List**

| \# | Message code | Message Type | Context | Content |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | MSG01 | In line | When a search returns no results | *No search results.*   |
| 2 | MSG02 | In red, under the text box | When required input fields are left empty | *The \* field is required.*  |
| 3 | MSG03 | Toast message | Updating asset(s) information successfully | *Update asset(s) successfully.*  |
| 4 | MSG04 | Toast message | Adding new asset successfully | *Add asset successfully.*  |
| 5 | MSG05 | Toast message | Deleting asset information successfully | *Delete asset(s) successfully.*  |
| 6 | MSG06 | In red, under the text box | Input value length \> max length | *Exceed max length of {max\_length}.*  |
| 7 | MSG07 | In line | The username or password is not correct when clicking sign-in button | *Incorrect user name or password. Please check again.* |
| 8 | MSG08 | Toast message | When the workflow syncs to the kiosk is successful | Workflow synchronized to the kiosk successfully |
| 9 | MSG09 | Toast message | When the workflow syncs to the kiosk fails | Failed to synchronize workflow to the kiosk. Please try again later. |
| 10 | MSG10 | In red, under the text box | When inputs violate validations | Invalid input. Please check your entry. |
